ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1.5 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white regions occupy the distal halves of both the left and right lobes. These are separated by a continuous, low-intensity black region centered at the median notch. The boundary between white and black regions exhibits significant pixel-level stippling and mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal angle of 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations detected along the entire trailing edge. Significant jagged peaks and valleys are visible, particularly on the right lobe where individual notches vary in depth by 10-20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly upturned lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of four distinct, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters on the high-intensity white region of the right lobe, and one similar circular cluster on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme jaggedness and missing pixel-mass on the trailing edge of the right lobe tip suggesting historical physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine-grained micro-stippling of low-intensity pixels concentrated at the interior margins of the white patches.
